elements.name: limitations-copy
elements.text:
• Single saved run; retrospective, non-preregistered hypothesis.
• Observational slice: page and document distribution are confounded (35/36 multi-page questions are also multi-document).
• Heterogeneous answer scoring and uneven answer-type composition.
• Raw-to-final comparison is diagnostic, not a causal ablation.
